title: DynaSchedBench：基于LLM调度代理的校准动态调度基准与可观测性悖论
summary: 提出DynaSchedBench框架，通过顺序事件空间校准器（SESC）和调度压力指数（SSI）对动态柔性作业车间调度问题（DFJSP）实例进行难度分层。发现LLM调度代理存在“可观测性悖论”：提供完整结构信息反而降低性能，且工具增强和优化策略无法可靠提升效果。
summary_en: Introduces DynaSchedBench, a diagnostic framework for DFJSP using Sequential Event-Space Calibrator (SESC) and Schedule Stress Index (SSI) to stratify instance difficulty. Identifies an 'Observability Paradox' in LLM scheduling agents: full structural information degrades performance, and tool-augmented strategies fail to reliably improve results.
